methodology: Signals reconstructed from Polymarket trade history for matches that were played before live signal tracking began. Wallet grades are walk-forward: a wallet's grade for a match uses only matches that had already settled when that match started, so no result can influence its own signal. The lock rule is identical to the live scanner. These calls were NOT published before the matches resolved and are therefore not independently verifiable the way the locked record is. Never combine the two into a single figure.
